dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sir Galahad is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Initially while in care, Galahad was observed to be fearful. Noted to balk when returning to kennel. Over time he warmed up to handlers and presented with a loose body and would offer the cues "sit" and "paw". Recently there have been two incidents where Galahad has jumped up and bitten the handler on the hand while they were attempting to leash him. In one instance, the bite broke skin, and in the other, it did not. Medically, Galahad is apparently healthy.

Sir Galahad arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. Initially while in care, Galahad was observed to be fearful. Noted to balk when returning to kennel. Over time he warmed up to handlers and presented with a loose body and would offer the cue "paw". Recently there have been two incidents where Galahad has jumped up and bitten the handler on the hand while they were attempting to leash him. In one instance, the bite broke skin, and in the other, it did not. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
